Delhi Power Demand Surges to Record High Amid Intense Heatwave

Delhi has experienced its highest-ever peak electricity demand, reaching 8,748 MW on a recent afternoon due to a severe heatwave. This figure surpasses the previous record set earlier in the week. The surge highlights the strain on the power grid during extreme weather conditions.
